items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did he give him “the Ray?” I keep hearing about that “Ray.” [INTERVIEWEE] No, that’s just a myth I think.

ctx.x: Well, when Benny was playing out there he decided he didn’t like the way Gene Krupa played anymore, for some reason, because he was the star of his early band, you know Gene. And he was trying to get him fired. I happened to be rooming with Gene on the set, like on the dressing rooms we shared the same dressing room. And he said, “the old man’s trying to get me fired.” But he couldn’t fire him because his contract was with the studio, not with Benny.
Did he give him “the Ray?” I keep hearing about that “Ray.”
No, that’s just a myth I think.
